# Data overview

## Source

SkillCorner open data (tracking + body pose): <https://github.com/SkillCorner/opendata>

Raw files are downloaded into `data/raw/` (git-ignored — not committed). Derived/cleaned tables used by
later chapters are written to `data/processed/`.

```{python}
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent / "src"))

from skillcorner_cup import data as scdata

scdata.RAW_DATA_DIR
```
